name: Explosion
summary: Explosion is a breakout EA that identifies sudden volatility expansion (explosive price moves) and enters trades in the direction of the momentum surge. It uses a combination of volatility filters and momentum indicators to detect high-probability breakout opportunities, entering when price action exceeds dynamic thresholds. The EA employs fixed or dynamic stop-loss and take-profit levels to manage risk on each trade.
summary_zh: Explosion是一个突破类EA，通过识别突然的波动率扩张（爆炸性价格移动）来顺势入场交易。它结合波动率过滤器和动量指标来检测高概率的突破机会，当价格行为超过动态阈值时入场。该EA采用固定或动态止损止盈水平来管理每笔交易的风险。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是捕捉波动率突然放大的突破行情，类似于布林带收缩后的突破。入场条件通常基于价格突破动态计算的通道或波动率阈值，并配合动量指标确认方向。出场条件包括固定点数止损止盈、追踪止损或指标反转信号。仓位管理方面，EA支持固定手数交易，部分版本可能加入基于账户余额的动态仓位计算。资金管理方面，止损设置相对明确但缺乏对最大回撤或连续亏损的保护机制。整体策略在趋势启动阶段表现较好，但在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号和连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept is to capture explosive volatility expansion breakouts, similar to Bollinger Band squeeze breakouts. Entry conditions are based on price breaking through dynamically calculated channels or volatility thresholds, confirmed by momentum indicators for direction. Exit conditions include fixed-pip stop-loss and take-profit, trailing stops, or indicator reversal signals. Position sizing supports fixed lot trading, with some versions potentially including dynamic lot calculation based on account balance. Money management has clearly defined stop-losses but lacks protection mechanisms for maximum drawdown or consecutive losses. The strategy performs well during trend initiation phases but is prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging markets.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description_en: EA magic number; 0 monitors all orders

pros: 捕捉波动率扩张的突破策略逻辑清晰，在趋势启动阶段盈亏比优势明显
具有明确的止损止盈设置，每笔交易风险可控
参数化设计灵活，交易者可根据不同品种和市场环境调整突破阈值和波动率周期
追踪止损功能有助于锁定浮动利润，避免盈利回吐
pros_en: Clear breakout logic capturing volatility expansion with favorable risk-reward ratios during trend initiation
Well-defined stop-loss and take-profit settings provide controlled risk per trade
Flexible parameterized design allows traders to adjust explosion thresholds and volatility periods for different instruments and market conditions
Trailing stop feature helps lock in floating profits and prevents giving back gains
cons: 在震荡盘整行情中容易产生大量虚假突破信号，导致频繁止损
缺乏最大回撤控制和连续亏损保护机制，极端行情下风险较大
未加入点差过滤和交易时段过滤，在高点差时段入场可能降低胜率
固定手数模式未考虑账户净值变化，不利于长期复利增长
cons_en: Prone to frequent false breakout signals in ranging/consolidating markets, leading to repeated stop-loss hits
Lacks maximum drawdown control and consecutive loss protection, posing significant risk during extreme market conditions
No spread filter or trading session filter, entering during high-spread periods may reduce win rate
Fixed lot sizing does not adapt to account equity changes, hindering long-term compounding growth
improvements: 增加震荡行情识别过滤器（如ADX或布林带宽度），在低波动率盘整期减少交易频率
加入基于账户风险的动态仓位计算和最大回撤保护机制，提高资金管理安全性
improvements_en: Add ranging market identification filters (such as ADX or Bollinger Band width) to reduce trade frequency during low-volatility consolidation periods
Implement risk-based dynamic position sizing and maximum drawdown protection mechanisms to improve capital management safety

risk_points: 突破策略在震荡行情中易产生连续虚假信号导致多次止损
缺乏最大回撤保护和连续亏损限制机制
未设置点差和交易时段过滤，可能在不利时段入场
risk_points_en: Breakout strategy prone to consecutive false signals causing repeated stop-losses in ranging markets
No maximum drawdown protection or consecutive loss limiting mechanism
No spread or trading session filter, potentially entering during unfavorable periods

The EA employs fixed or dynamic stop-loss and take-profit levels to manage risk on each trade.
